finding_key: docs/design/slides/slides-keyboard-shortcuts.md::canonical design doc not updated for the new `data-text-edit-keepalive` exemption. the doc's "it deliberately does nothing when" list (lines 147-160) is the spec for this hook and is now incomplete; worse, its last bullet asserts text-edit controls are handled purely by the deferred activeelement re-read ("which is what makes text-edit controls … no-ops"), which the delta contradicts by adding an explicit keepalive special case in `toolbar-focus-release.ts:76`. contributing expects the behaviour change to be folded into the canonical subsystem doc.
evidence: The hook explicitly exempts `data-text-edit-keepalive` controls in isReleasable() (toolbar-focus-release.ts:~43,76, plus a dedicated test), but the design doc's "It deliberately does nothing when" list in slides-keyboard-shortcuts.md lists only four guards and never mentions the keepalive attribute. Moreover, the doc's fourth bullet attributes text-edit safety solely to the deferred activeElement re-read, while the code's own comment explains keepalive controls hold focus and would be wrongly released by that mechanism alone — so the doc is both incomplete and misleading. I could not verify the CONTRIBUTING reference, but the doc/code mismatch is directly verifiable from the supplied files. Doc-only issue, no runtime impact.
